title: Varginha records strictly classified at the Ministry of Defense

tellings.quote: The information that's held by the Ministry of Defense is strictly classified.

plain: Brazil's Ministry of Defense keeps its records on the 1996 Varginha case, in which witnesses say a craft came down in a Brazilian town and a creature was taken, under tight secrecy. That is what Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, tells Michels: "The information that's held by the Ministry of Defense is strictly classified." Coming from a former minister, it would mean the government holds files on the case that the public cannot see.
